'''2010 Canadian Nationals Jon Lewis LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jon Lewis]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4)|VB4-L-carefulplanning-pre.gif|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
